Be careful, young one. Don't be pulled into their plans, their evil. I can't tell you anything else.|Vaik'anna Silverlight, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VS" />}}
'''Vaik'anna Silverlight''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was employed in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Roric V`lia]]. The Twi'lek used to gossip with spacers about the activities of her boss that were related to the [[Imperial Weapon Research Facility]], the [[Maulers]] criminals and the [[Imperial vs. Gungan Battle|war between the Empire and the Gungans]]. Vaik'anna Silverlight once met [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="SWG:VS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaik'anna Silverlight was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vaik'anna Silverlight was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
